I got lost in the library when I was younger. I'm not sure how old I was.
I remember going into the elevator, and somehow it took me to the basement.
It felt very industrial, or unfinished, and I was pretty scared.

A nice man found me and brought me back into the elevator. He took me up
to the main floor and back to my mom.
